SELECT
    s.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
    s.StoreName AS StoreName,
    sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toQuarter(f.DateKey) = 3) AS Q3Sales,
    sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toQuarter(f.DateKey) = 4) AS Q4Sales,
    Q4Sales - Q3Sales AS SalesChange,
    (Q4Sales - Q3Sales) * 100.0 / nullif(Q3Sales, 0) AS PctChange
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS s ON f.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
  AND toQuarter(f.DateKey) IN (3, 4)
GROUP BY s.StoreKey, s.StoreName
HAVING Q3Sales > 0 AND Q4Sales < Q3Sales
ORDER BY PctChange ASC
